correctness.rationale: Rank-one outer products force commutation iff both products vanish, including same-image and different-image cases. The span-of-images/common-kernel containment proves each maximal clique equals precisely X_U and U is uniquely recovered. The displayed Gaussian Möbius inversion counts ordered tuples by exact image span; signed Stirling inversion counts unordered distinct cliques. Fixed image-line counting gives regular degree. Projective flags and common-neighbor kernel intersections give diameters 3 and 2, respectively. Explicit standard-library exhaustive checks passed for n=2,3,4 and q=2,3,4. The proof, not finite tests, supports arbitrary q,n.
